owner: src/tools/profile_tools/schema/ the bounded schema subset, its raw decode, its one validator, and the host's input revision and schema binding, through the public session, planner, TUI, probe, and workflow entries

responses_off_recording.how: fixtures/responses-off-golden.json was written by running the public session over the Responses API, with no schema profile tool, against the unchanged production code of responses_off_base_sha in a git-archive copy of that commit, through a loopback fake on 127.0.0.1 behind the OpenAI-compatible entry; the recorder file tests/profile_tool_schema_responses.rs existed in the copy only, and the copy's src/ was diffed against the archive with no difference
responses_off_recording.command: RESPONSES_OFF_OUT=<out> HEAVY_LOCK_CLASS=cargo with-heavy-lock cargo test -j 4 --test profile_tool_schema_responses -- --exact responses_off::records_the_responses_off_golden, run twice; the two outputs were byte-identical
responses_off_recording.normalization: the six number keys of the existing off comparison (tests/structured_stage_receipts.rs NORMALIZED_NUMBER_FIELDS: epoch, occurred_at_epoch_ms, duration_ms, elapsed_ms, estimated_prompt_tokens_sent, estimated_stable_prefix_chars) become "<N>" when the value is a number; inside strings the temporary roots become <ROOT>, the loopback URL <LOOPBACK>, times <TIME>, nonces and UUIDs <NONCE-n>/<UUID-n>, 16-hex revisions <REVISION-n>; nothing else, and no reasoning, preamble, argument, strict, call_id, item id, summary, encrypted_content, unknown item, or history value is normalized

synthetic_source.cases: hand-written generic profiles (a settings object and a document index), operator descriptors, and raw replies; none is copied from a run, a benchmark task, or an issue evidence file
synthetic_source.base_observation: fixtures/off-golden.json was written by running the public session against the production code of base_sha with a recorder test that does not remain in this repository; the expectations of the off rows therefore do not come from the new implementation
synthetic_source.excluded: no live model, real key, external provider, Jev call, benchmark task, grader input, expected answer, generated code, run record, or host path is stored here
